what: On every hover, an animate.css effect (bounce, rubberBand, wobble, bounceOutLeft …) plays once, then is removed so it can play again next time (1s) — a hand-drawn shop prank where cut-out doll photos and drawings bounce, wobble or fly off sideways and back when touched
note: The original used AniJS (not on npm), so the same behavior was rewritten (add a class on mouseover, remove it on animationend). It is not attached on devices without a pointer. If attached to the same element as the reveal effect (animate-reveal) the classes collide, so attach it to an inner element.
